text:
The op-amp latched because the feedback polarity is reversed. I'm swapping the input-pair gates and opening up the tail headroom.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Polarity was reversed: out1 follows vinp and M6 inverts, so unity feedback was positive and the amp latched (vout=0, M2/M4/M6 off). Swap the input gates. Raise input-pair and tail-mirror gm/Id so the tail device has Vds headroom at Vcm=0.9 V."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (18, 12, 22),          # input pair gm/Id (high -> low Vgs, tail headroom)
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),       # input pair L (flicker noise / gain)
    "itail": (40e-6, 10e-6, 80e-6), # first-stage tail current
    "gmidp": (8, 5, 12),            # PMOS mirror + M6 gm/Id (matched -> no systematic offset)
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),       # PMOS L
    "i2":    (200e-6, 80e-6, 350e-6),
    "gmidn": (12, 8, 15),           # NMOS bias mirror gm/Id (low Vdsat for tail)
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "cc":    (2e-12, 0.8e-12, 4e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.5, 1.0, 3.0),       # Rz = rzk / gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it, i2, cc = p["itail"], p["i2"], p["cc"]
    i1 = it / 2

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.25)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i1, vds=0.9)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], i2, vds=0.9)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], it, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], i2, vds=0.9)

    rz = p["rzk"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    # vinn on the diode side: out1 follows vinn (non-inverting w.r.t. vinn, inverting w.r.t. vinp)
    # M6 inverts again -> vout non-inverting w.r.t. vinp, inverting w.r.t. vinn. Correct polarity.
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * cc + c1 * cl + cc * cl))
    pm_mirror = math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / (m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg))))
    wz = 1.0 / (cc * (rz - 1.0 / m6.gm)) if rz > 1.0 / m6.gm else 1e30
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / p2)) - pm_mirror + \
         math.degrees(math.atan(2 * PI * gbw / wz))
    kT = 1.380649e-23 * 300.15
    sv2 = 2 * (8.0 / 3.0) * kT / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise_th = math.sqrt(sv2)
    power = vdd * (iref + iref + it + i2)
    slew = min(it / cc, i2 / (cc + cl))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "noise_1k": noise_th * 2.0, "slew": slew}
```
